checks.requirement: Material names and nominal densities are parsed from the pinned generator; physical properties and coupon evidence remain required.
checks.status_rule: FAIL for unknown declared material; BLOCKED when physical layup/coupon evidence is missing; PASS is not available from nominal density metadata alone.

checks.requirement: Map every source mass-table row to its declared material, retaining non-geometrized point masses as explicit exclusions, and label sourced inputs, process proposals, and missing measured/qualified properties.
checks.status_rule: FAIL for stale/mismatched source hashes, duplicate/missing parts, absent/non-positive density, or a PLA/carbon-rod/servo-envelope assignment to the duct/hot-side screening class; BLOCKED for absent required files or because no allowables, coupon evidence, measured mass, thermal history, adhesive/bolt details, or complete process traveler are supplied. Mandatory BLOCKED returns nonzero. This inventory cannot PASS manufacturing or structural acceptance.

checks.requirement: Native stock-nest STEP solids import and have positive volume; finished rotor machining, fixtures, tool reach and containment require separate evidence.
checks.status_rule: FAIL for invalid/missing stock solids; BLOCKED when machine/process and finished-rotor evidence is missing; stock blanks alone cannot PASS manufacturing release.
